newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Minorco venture exercizes Argentine option.
newsitem.headline: Minorco venture exercizes Argentine option.

text.p: Minera Mincorp SA, held equally by Minorco and Argentina's Perez Companc has exercized its option to develop the Cerro Vanguardia gold deposit in southern Argentina, the partners said Friday.

"Construction of the treatment plant and the necessary support infrastructre has recently started and will require investment of over $230 million over the next two years. It is intended that this amount will be procured as project financing," Minorco, Perez Companc and Santa Cruz province mining company Fomicruz said in a joint statement.

Mining reserves are 9.3 million tonnes at the Cerro Vanguardia site in Santa Cruz province, at a grade of 9.5 grams gold and 111 grams of silver, containing 2.7 million ounces of gold and 27.2 million ounces of silver.
Production is scheduled to start in mid 1998, with full output being attained at the end of that year. Mine life is estimated at 14 years.
The construction and exploitation of the mine will be undertaken by Cerro Vanguardia SA, which as part of a restructuring takes over the functions of Minera Mincorp.
As part of the restructuring, Fomicruz will become a 7.5 percent shareholder of Cerro Vanguardia SA, with Minorco and Perez Companc equally holding the balance.
